in_marathi.name: Dihaan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dihaan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Dihaan is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Dih’, meaning day or sun. This name is a tribute to the eternal and radiant power of the sun, symbolizing vitality, strength, and wisdom.
